onset.Description: Seconds from the session clock origin.

event_id.Description: SKOS notation of the authoritative SSTIM session event type. Categorical: a value repeats whenever the same kind of occurrence happens again. Levels link each code to its SSTIM definition, and the HED map generates the interoperable annotation.

session-open.Description: Opens the session scope defined as Sstim-session.

playback-start.Description: Opens the delivery scope defined as Sstim-delivery.

parameter-changed.Description: A delivery quantity was set to a new value part-way through the session. Experiment-control places it as a control action rather than a stimulus, Controller-agent names the delivering system as the actor, Modify names the act it performed, and the detail tags carry which parameter and what it became — which is what makes a segmented stimulus recoverable from the events table.

safety-limit-applied.Description: A delivery parameter was constrained by a safety boundary. The delivering system is the actor, the act is a modification, and Constrained names the constraining within it; the detail tags name the parameter and the value actually delivered.

session-complete.Description: Closes the session scope after the intended duration was delivered.

sstim_event_id.Description: Local name of the sstim:SessionEvent occurrence this row was generated from. Joins the row to the source graph and to the manifest's crossArtifactIds; ADR 0025 decision 6.

event-open.Description: The session-open occurrence at 0.000 seconds on the session clock.

event-start.Description: The playback-start occurrence at 0.300 seconds on the session clock.

event-step-theta.Description: The parameter-changed occurrence at 120.000 seconds on the session clock.

event-step-gamma.Description: The parameter-changed occurrence at 240.000 seconds on the session clock.

event-safety.Description: The safety-limit-applied occurrence at 300.000 seconds on the session clock.

event-complete.Description: The session-complete occurrence at 600.000 seconds on the session clock.

sstim_hed_definitions.Description: HED definitions the event_id annotations reference. Not a column of events.tsv. Onset and Offset are scope tags requiring exactly one paired Def/, so the events do not validate without these in scope.

SstimDurationConvention.Description: duration is always n/a in this bundle. SSTIM session events are instantaneous timeline marks, and inventing a duration would assert a span the native record does not contain. This is a note, not a redefinition of the BIDS-required duration column.

SstimEndOfRecordingConvention.Description: The final session-complete or session-interrupt row is also the end of this recording. HED temporal processing keeps an Onset active through end-of-file when no later matching Offset exists. If delivery is still open, its Sstim-delivery scope therefore ends with the recording; no playback-stop row is invented because the native SSTIM timeline contains none.

SstimGeneratedAnnotationNote.Description: HED 8.4.0 annotations are assembled from the event_id HED level map rather than materialised in events.tsv. Where an event changes a parameter, the annotation splices parameter_kind and value_after. SSTIM is canonical and HED is derived, so the native columns are the ones to read.

parameter_kind.Description: Local name of the sstim:StimulationParameterKind this event changed, or n/a. Modality-neutral by design: the kind names the quantity, not one application's field.

value_before.Description: The value the parameter held immediately before the event, or n/a. On a safety-limit event this is the value that was requested.

value_after.Description: The value the parameter held immediately after the event, or n/a. On a safety-limit event this is the value actually delivered. The unit follows from the parameter kind and is deliberately not repeated per row.
